Requirement: Provide one global employee, organisation and position record for all countries, with local variants handled by configuration.
Acceptance criteria: One person and one employment record per employee; no parallel HR system after the final wave.

Requirement: Control headcount through approved positions.
Acceptance criteria: 100% of hires and transfers into approved positions after pilot.

Requirement: Make joiner, mover and leaver changes faster and consistent.
Acceptance criteria: Median time to effective change down [40]% against baseline.

Requirement: Give one benefits model with local plans and carriers.
Acceptance criteria: One benefits data model across [50] countries; local plans by configuration.

Requirement: Measure and own workforce data quality end to end.
Acceptance criteria: Named owners; quality scorecard published monthly.

Requirement: Meet privacy, retention and works-council rules in every country.
Acceptance criteria: Region and retention rules applied; deletion evidence available.

Requirement: Replace any partner in a category without redesign.
Acceptance criteria: Exit plan tested yearly per category; adapter-only replacement.

Requirement: Deliver in waves with SAP Activate, starting with a pilot.
Acceptance criteria: Pilot live before waves 2 to 4; quality gates passed.

Requirement: Employees and managers can complete common changes on mobile.
Acceptance criteria: Top [10] requests available on mobile in the pilot.

Requirement: HR agents see a role-limited record without switching systems.
Acceptance criteria: Agent view from the case, field access by role.

Requirement: Total Rewards and Payroll receive correct data on time.
Acceptance criteria: Reconciliation within [0.1]% each cycle.

Requirement: Finance sees positions, headcount and cost aligned.
Acceptance criteria: Position to cost-centre link complete for 100% of active positions.

Requirement: Legal and works councils can see what is collected, why and for how long.
Acceptance criteria: Processing register and retention table available.

Requirement: IT Security controls partner access.
Acceptance criteria: Scoped credentials; access review each quarter.

Requirement: Procurement can compare and replace vendors fairly.
Acceptance criteria: Scorecard used for every selection; exit terms in contracts.

Requirement: Regional HR leaders keep local rules and languages.
Acceptance criteria: Country variants by configuration; no code fork.

Requirement: Maintain the organisation structure with effective dating and country variants.
Acceptance criteria: Create, change and publish a unit with history.

Requirement: Create, approve, change and close positions with workflow.
Acceptance criteria: Position status and history; link to person.

Requirement: Maintain a job and skills catalogue mapped to country jobs.
Acceptance criteria: Job family and grade mapping per country.

Requirement: Create the person and employment from an accepted offer.
Acceptance criteria: No re-keying; duplicates blocked.

Requirement: Support transfers, promotions and other changes with approval rules.
Acceptance criteria: Rule-driven routes; changes effective-dated.

Requirement: Order right-to-work checks and store only outcome and date.
Acceptance criteria: No document images in the hub.

Requirement: Generate and sign employee documents.
Acceptance criteria: Template to signed file in one flow.

Requirement: Administer benefits with eligibility, enrolment and life events.
Acceptance criteria: Eligibility by rule; carrier confirmations stored.

Requirement: Send pay data to payroll and receive reconciliation.
Acceptance criteria: Cycle file or API; exceptions listed.

Requirement: Exchange time and absence data.
Acceptance criteria: Schedules and balances shared hourly.

Requirement: Manage global assignments.
Acceptance criteria: Assignment record linked to home and host.

Requirement: Hold contingent worker records and end dates.
Acceptance criteria: Access ends with contract.

Requirement: Provision and remove access from record events.
Acceptance criteria: Joiner, mover and leaver events reach IT within [1] hour.

Requirement: Run cases with service levels and knowledge.
Acceptance criteria: Case open to close within service level.

Requirement: Run statutory reports by country.
Acceptance criteria: Reports reproducible and signed off.

Requirement: Delete or anonymise data by retention rule.
Acceptance criteria: Deletion evidence per record.

Requirement: Publish headcount and quality dashboards.
Acceptance criteria: Dashboards from the data platform, no direct identifiers.

Requirement: Register every AI use, with advisory-only limits.
Acceptance criteria: AI register complete before use.

Requirement: Availability of the core record and APIs.
Acceptance criteria: [99.5]% monthly.

Requirement: Performance of self-service and approvals.
Acceptance criteria: 95% of pages under [3] seconds.

Requirement: Integration recovery.
Acceptance criteria: No lost events; replay within [4] hours.

Requirement: Least-privilege access.
Acceptance criteria: Role review each quarter; no shared accounts.

Requirement: Encryption and key control.
Acceptance criteria: In transit and at rest; keys rotated.

Requirement: Audit of reads and changes of sensitive data.
Acceptance criteria: Events kept for [7] years.

Requirement: Data residency by country.
Acceptance criteria: Region map applied; evidence on request.

Requirement: Accessibility and language.
Acceptance criteria: WCAG 2.1 AA; languages per country.

Requirement: Partner API versioning and contract tests.
Acceptance criteria: Tests pass on every partner release.

Requirement: Support and release rhythm.
Acceptance criteria: Quarterly release tested before production.

Requirement: Backup and recovery.
Acceptance criteria: RPO [1] hour; RTO [4] hours.

Requirement: Monitoring of every partner flow.
Acceptance criteria: Alert within [5] minutes of failure.

Requirement: Migrate employee, organisation and position data by country cluster.
Acceptance criteria: Reconciliation of counts and key fields; legacy frozen at cutover.

Requirement: Cleanse data to quality rules before load.
Acceptance criteria: Rules DQ-01 to DQ-12 pass above threshold.

Requirement: Train HR, managers and employees by role.
Acceptance criteria: Role-based curriculum delivered before go-live.

Requirement: Run hypercare with defined exit.
Acceptance criteria: Exit criteria met for [4] weeks.

Requirement: Rehearse cutover and rollback.
Acceptance criteria: Dress rehearsal passed; rollback timed.

Requirement: Retire legacy HR systems and local tools.
Acceptance criteria: Read-only archive; tools decommissioned by wave.
